pages.text: Beyond $(item)Otherworld Log$() and $(item)Otherstone$() there are also otherworld materials that require special tools to harvest.$(br2)This pickaxe is rather brittle, but it will do the job.$(br)
These gems, when infused with a spirit, can be used to interact with Otherword materials and are the key to crafting the pickaxe.$(br)

pages.title: Crafting
pages.text: After preparing the raw materials, the pickaxe needs to be infused with a spirit.$(br2)Follow the instructions at $(l:crafting_rituals/craft_infused_pickaxe)Craft Infuse Pickaxe$(/l)$(br)
